'''Contispex XIX''' was the last [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] belonging to the [[Pius Dea]] faith.

==Biography==
Contispex followed in the [[Contispex dynasty]] as Supreme Chancellor of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and ruled during the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict|civil war]] between the [[Pius Dea|Faithful]] and the [[Renunciates]].

When the Republic warships were lured into a trap by their enemies, his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Flame of Sinthara]]'' was [[Battle of Uquine|caught]] by Renunciate [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] and the Chancellor was seized by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the bridge. He was later taken to [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], where he was tried and imprisoned for the rest of his life, without the possibility of communicating with his now dwindling group of followers.
